title: B0-repro: our model (w4base_s0) in the withdrawn second scorer's slot of the public 0.480 notebook

rules.metric: public LB MRR@25, read as the 3-decimal score Kaggle displays

references.source: docs/research_plan.md Annex B (the 0.480 notebook's own tables)

bands.name: adds
bands.consequence: our model stays the second scorer in every later probe; the next probe changes one thing only (an exploration winner or the z-weight, the latter tuned offline first)

bands.name: tie
bands.consequence: a reproducible ~0.48 without the withdrawn scorer: B0-repro becomes the base of record; the next probe only when an offline exploration clears its own rule

bands.name: subtracts
bands.consequence: the base of record falls back to the public-only pipeline; no further probe with our model before diagnosing (per-class replay on eval-c3, rank-1 moves) why an offline +0.136 model loses in the pipeline

limitations: ~125 public molecules: one molecule moving rank 2 -> 1 is worth ~0.004-0.008
the public split is 31 % of the test; the private score is what counts

notes: The 0.480 notebook's own variants of the second-scorer weight (0.3/0.4/0.6) all scored 0.474: its 0.5 was chosen on the public LB, so its 0.480 carries selection bias and paired changes of ranks 2-25 commonly read -0.006 there.
Consequence applied: base of record is the public-only pipeline; no probe with our model before the diagnosis.
